column1: # Remote lab link profiles. One line per profile, whitespace separated.
#   rtt_ms     round-trip time. The wan container adds half of it in each
#              direction.
#   jitter_ms  round-trip jitter (+/-). Half of it in each direction, uniform.
#   loss_pct   random packet loss, applied in EACH direction.
#   down_mbit  rate toward the client (the NAS uplink). 0 = no limit.
#   up_mbit    rate toward the NAS (the client uplink). 0 = no limit.
# name      rtt_ms  jitter_ms  loss_pct  down_mbit  up_mbit
same-city   20      0          0         200        200
# fast-remote: a same-region remote over a direct tunnel (Tailscale, fiber).
# Measured on a real path: ping 11.6 ms median (p95 32), one stream 303 down / 212 up.
fast-remote 12      10         0.1       300        200
abroad      200     0          1         30         30
# abroad without the loss: tells the cost of distance from the cost of loss.
abroad-noloss 200   0          0         30         30
cellular    120     60         0         20         20
# thin-near: a near but thin link (a phone underlay the OS does not flag),
# under the 3 MiB/s metered threshold. Checks the metered class holds.
thin-near   20      0          0         16         8
# down: every packet lost both ways (a link outage; engine-life-lab.sh E6).
